title: Dispatch RFU 4: The Cloud Holds a Street No Longer There
summary: Witnesses see the outline of demolished houses above them.
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: At noon the cloud briefly showed roofs and a line of chimney pots. Archivist Agnes Morrow identified the view as Old Weaver Street, demolished after the flood of 1949. The present courtyard occupies its former drainage basin.

The rising water may be following the old street’s course in the Stratum. Voss found its covered culvert still open below ground. If the cloud continues to accumulate water, he warns, it may discharge through a route that no longer exists in Alderwick.
